risk_summary: The excerpt presents strong, well-quantified 2021 revenue and earnings growth, supported by acquisitions, pandemic-related demand, and broad geographic performance. It also identifies meaningful exposures, including supply-chain disruption, labor constraints and costs, COVID-19 variants, foreign currency, regulation, competition, technological change, and acquisition integration. Risk disclosure is generally substantive but includes substantial standard MD&A boilerplate and forward-looking, qualified language.
